create_ecapa_tdnn_model: create an ECAPA_TDNN model from an EcapaTDNNConfig with optional device and dtype
build_ecapa_tdnn_model: build an ECAPA_TDNN model using EcapaTDNNBuilder with config, device, and dtype parameters
define_ecapa_tdnn_arch: define a custom ECAPA_TDNN architecture config using the ecapa_tdnn_arch decorator
configure_ecapa_tdnn: configure ECAPA_TDNN hyperparameters including channels, kernel sizes, dilations, and embed dim
register_ecapa_tdnn_arch: register a named ECAPA_TDNN architecture variant in the ecapa_tdnn_archs registry
